verdict.rationale: Bolt's own authentication docs describe an option that lets a project's users sign up with their email address, and Bolt can add Supabase authentication to an app. That covers builder-provided email sign-up. Social-provider login and the depth of the scaffolded login and sign-up flows are not documented in the pack. Missing for 10: social provider (OAuth) login evidence, details of the scaffolded login/sign-up UI and flows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: This option allows your project's users to sign up using their email address.
Use Supabase with Bolt to add a database, authentication, or edge functions to your app as an alternative to Bolt Database.
